properties.name: airplay.serverName
properties.description: Receiver name shown in the iPhone Screen Mirroring list.

properties.name: airplay.width
properties.description: Maximum advertised width, or auto to detect the sender video stream after setup.

properties.name: airplay.height
properties.description: Maximum advertised height, or auto to detect the sender video stream after setup.

properties.name: airplay.fps
properties.description: Maximum advertised frame rate, or auto to detect the sender video timestamps after setup.

properties.name: airplay.audioJitterPackets
properties.description: Audio packet reorder window from 1 to 64.

properties.name: airplay.requirePairing
properties.description: Require Pair-Verify before accepting media setup.

properties.name: player.gstreamer.swing
properties.description: Use a Swing video component instead of the native GStreamer video sink.

properties.name: player.gstreamer.videoDecoder
properties.description: GStreamer H.264 decoder element or auto.

properties.name: player.gstreamer.gpuAdapter
properties.description: DXGI adapter index for matching per-device D3D11/D3D12 decoder and sink elements, or auto to enumerate and select a capable hardware adapter.

properties.name: player.gstreamer.videoQueueDepth
properties.description: Maximum decrypted video access units queued, from 1 to 16.
